name: Sauli
source:
"A person's beauty comes through even more through their flaws."

An associate professor at New Sieg Academia with top-of-the-class skills as a surgeon. He's well-versed in psychology and sometimes acts as a consultant for the New Sieg police force. Sauli is Helvetica's guardian and cherishes him as though he were his real son.
